components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 52px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--forest-dark); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--forest-dark); color: white; font: 700 1rem/1.4 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #1c5544; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b77a00; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Fruit Chip
components.description: Names the supported fruit types near the upload task.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #c9d7c8; border-radius: 999px; background: #f9fbf7; color: var(--forest-dark); font: 650 0.9rem/1.35 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Inspection Ticket
components.description: Holds the model stamp, upload target, action, and policy note.
components.html:
Periksa satu foto

Pilih satu apel, pisang, atau jeruk.
components.css: .ds-ticket { padding: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px); border: 1px solid #d5dfd5; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgb(23 59 49 / 8%); } .ds-ticket strong { font: 740 1.28rem/1.3 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-ticket p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 0.94rem/1.55 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Upload Target
components.description: Keyboard-accessible dashed target for choosing a photo.
components.css: .ds-upload { min-height: 258px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 24px 18px; border: 1.5px dashed #a9bdab; border-radius: 12px; background: #f8faf6; color: var(--ink); text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-upload:hover, .ds-upload:focus-within { border-color: var(--forest); background: #f2f7ee; } .ds-upload input { width: 1px; height: 1px; position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-upload input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid #b77a00; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-upload span { font: 700 1rem/1.4 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-upload small { color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 0.83rem/1.4 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Keeps the two in-page destinations quiet and easy to scan.
components.html: Cara kerjaBatas hasil
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink-soft); font: 600 0.95rem/1.4 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 5px; transition: color 160ms ease, text-decoration-color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--forest-dark); text-decoration-color: var(--forest); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b77a00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Review Result
components.description: Shows an uncertain outcome with a distinct amber tint and plain language.
components.html:
Perlu diperiksa

Periksa kembali kondisi buah secara langsung.
components.css: .ds-result { padding: 17px; border: 1px solid #e8d290; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--review-pale); color: #5f4109; } .ds-result strong { font: 780 1.22rem/1.35 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-result p { margin: 8px 0 0; font: 400 0.91rem/1.55 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-result:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b77a00; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
CekBuah treats a fruit photo like a single item brought to a contemporary market stall for inspection. Its interface uses the familiar structure of a produce ticket: a bold identification, a clear upload area, and one plain-language result. The visual character is practical and bright, with crate greens, citrus accents, and paper-like surfaces.

The interface keeps the task ahead of decoration. One supported fruit photo moves through preview and an explicit check; the resulting state stays readable through both words and color. The current model policy presents “Busuk” or “Perlu diperiksa” and keeps automatic “Segar” locked.
keyCharacteristics: Market greens and citrus yellow frame a clean, paper-white inspection surface.
Manrope carries the hierarchy from large, direct headings to compact ticket labels.
Result states use quiet tinted panels and always pair color with a written status.

rules.name: The Result Mark Rule
rules.body: Use amber for uncertain results and the tomato tint for Busuk or errors; color always appears alongside a plain text label.

rules.name: The One-Photo Rule
rules.body: Keep the upload target and explicit action on one ticket. Show one result for one submitted image.

dos: **Do** keep the supported fruit labels near the upload task.
**Do** pair every result tint with a written status and its short explanation.
**Do** preserve the clear two-column desktop layout and the single-column mobile flow.
**Do** keep keyboard focus visible with the existing amber outline treatment.
donts: **Don't** present automatic “Segar” as an available result while the model safety gate is locked.
**Don't** make status depend on color alone.
**Don't** let decorative market motifs compete with the photo preview or upload action.
